description: notify.class.update with a template reaching outside the closed placeholder set is refused at the door with ErrClassTemplate and nothing is written: a hint can carry ids and enums only — no prompt, goal, name or message is placeable anywhere a template could quote it, so an outbound notification can never be made to leak a person's work (SV4, SV6).

data.what: notify: template names "{goalText}", which is not a placeholder (the closed set is rootSlug, loopSlug, reasonKind, severity, count)
data.means: a hint can carry ids and enums and nothing else: prompts, goals, names and messages never reach a template, so an outbound notification cannot be made to quote a person's work (SV6)
data.todo: edit the template to use only the closed placeholders (notify.vocabulary lists them), or leave the shipped template as it is
